title-group.article-title: Synthetic teaching case: a fictional patient

abstract.p: ABSTRACT_ONLY_TEXT: A fabricated abstract used to test separation.

sec.title: Background
sec.p: BACKGROUND_ONLY_TEXT: General disease information must not enter the clinical prompt.

sec.title: Case presentation
sec.p: A fictional adult reported a cough lasting two days. No prior respiratory illness was recorded.
The measured temperature was 37.4 degrees Celsius. A synthetic radiograph showed a small opacity Figure 1.
Supportive treatment was provided. Symptoms resolved at the fictional seven-day follow-up.

sec.p: DIAGNOSIS_EXPOSITION_ONLY_TEXT: A deliberately fictional concluding diagnostic argument.
